build_convnet_standard: build a ConvNet with standard convolution layers for image feature extraction
build_convnet_transposed: build a ConvNet with transposed convolution layers for image upsampling
create_convnet_gelu_layers: create a ConvNet that applies GELU activation between convolutional layers
test_convnet_normalize: test a ConvNet with normalized output using LayerNorm
review_convnet_forward: review the ConvNet forward pass that applies sequential convolutions with configurable features, kernel sizes, and strides
